chutnee.definition:
n. A warm or spicy condiment or pickle made in India,
   compounded of various vegetable substances, sweets, acids, etc.
chutnee.translation: n. 印度酸辣调味料的一种

chutney.definition: n. a spicy condiment made of chopped fruits or vegetables cooked in vinegar and sugar with ginger and spices
chutney.translation: n. 酸辣酱, 一种酸辣调味品

chuvash.translation: n. 楚瓦什人；楚瓦什语

chvipurin.translation: [医] 克拉维普林(成药,一种麦角制剂)

chwa.translation: abbr. California Health and Welfare 加利福尼亚卫生及福利（事业）; California Health and Welfare Agency 加利福尼亚卫生与福利机构

chylaceous.definition:
a. Possessed of the properties of chyle; consisting of
   chyle.

chylaqueous.definition:
a. Consisting of chyle much diluted with water; -- said
   of a liquid which forms the circulating fluid of some inferior animals.

chyle.definition: n. a milky fluid consisting of lymph and emulsified fats; formed in the small intestine during digestion of ingested fats

chylifaction.definition:
n. The act or process by which chyle is formed from food
   in animal bodies; chylification, -- a digestive process.

chylifactive.definition: a producing or converting into chyle

chyliferous.translation: [医] 形成乳糜的, 输送乳糜的

chylification.definition: n. The formation of chyle. See Chylifaction.
chylification.translation: [医] 乳糜形成, 乳糜生成

chylify.definition: v. t. & i. To make chyle of; to be converted into chyle.

chyloderma.definition: n swelling of the scrotum resulting from chronic lymphatic obstruction
chyloderma.translation: [医] 阴囊象皮病, 阴囊淋巴管扩张, 阴囊淋巴肿

chylomicron.definition: n a microscopic particle of triglycerides produced in the intestines during digestion; in the bloodstream they release their fatty acids into the blood

chylopericardium.translation: [医] 乳糜心包, 乳糜性心包积液

chylopleura.translation: [医] 乳糜胸, 乳糜性水胸

chylopoiesis.translation: [医] 乳糜形成, 乳糜生成

chylous.definition: a consisting of chyle or having the properties of chyle

chyluria.definition:
n. A morbid condition in which the urine contains chyle or
   fatty matter, giving it a milky appearance.

chyme.definition: n. a semiliquid mass of partially digested food that passes from the stomach through the pyloric sphincter into the duodenum

chymification.definition:
n. The conversion of food into chyme by the digestive
   action of gastric juice.

chymosin.definition: n an enzyme that occurs in gastric juice; causes milk to coagulate

chymotrypsin.translation:
n. 胰凝乳蛋白酶, 糜蛋白酶
[化] 胰凝乳蛋白酶; 糜蛋白酶

chymotrypsinogen.translation: n. [生化]胰凝乳蛋白酶原,糜蛋白酶原

chymous.definition: a. Of or pertaining to chyme.

chypre.translation: <法>n.西普香水(一种檀香型香精)[字面意义：Cyprus, 疑为此香精的首产地]

chyron.translation: n. 字幕（在剧本中，等于lower third）

chytridiomycetes.definition: n. a class of mostly aquatic fungi; saprophytic or parasitic on algae or fungi or plants
